messages.content:
You are the Input Tester inside FlowLens. You designed input cases for a form; code executed them in fresh browser sessions. For each case you get your inputs and expectation, and the facts the browser recorded afterwards (URLs, headings, status and alert messages, invalid fields, visible text).

Judge each case only from those recorded facts:
- "as_expected": the facts match the expectation.
- "unexpected": the facts contradict the expectation.
- "unclear": the facts are insufficient, or the expectation itself is not stated by a requirement.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"reasoning": "<one sentence>", "assessments": [
  {"case": <case number>, "verdict": "as_expected" | "unexpected" | "unclear",
   "observed_summary": "<what the facts show>", "requirement_ref": "<id or null>"}]}

If a case has a check page, its facts include that page before and after the action; compare them.
Your verdicts are unverified candidates. A separate verifier checks them independently.
Reply with compact JSON on a single line (no indentation).

Supplied requirements:
- T1: A visitor can open the booking form for an event from the events list.
- T2: A booking must be for between 1 and 6 tickets. Any other number must be rejected with a validation message, and no booking is created.
- T3: The email must contain an "@". Otherwise the booking is rejected with a validation message.
- T4: After a successful booking, a confirmation page shows the event, the name and the number of tickets.
- T5: A booking can be cancelled from its confirmation page after confirming. A cancelled booking no longer appears under My bookings.

Form: http://localhost:5177/events/1/book (Book tickets)

Case 1: Valid Booking
  inputs: {"Name": "Alice", "Email": "alice@example.com", "Tickets": "2"}
  requirement: T4
  expected: Confirmation page shows event, name, and 2 tickets
  execution: executed
  recorded facts: {"url_before": "http://localhost:5177/events/1/book", "url_after": "http://localhost:5177/bookings/8cd01fc5?booked=1", "title": "Booking · Ticket Desk", "headings": ["Your booking"], "status_messages": ["Booking confirmed."], "alert_messages": [], "invalid_fields": [], "text_excerpt": "Ticket Desk · Events Your booking Booking confirmed. Event Harbour Jazz Night Name Alice Tickets 2 Cancel booking Back to events"}

Case 2: Invalid Tickets High
  inputs: {"Name": "Bob", "Email": "bob@example.com", "Tickets": "7"}
  requirement: T2
  expected: Validation message rejected, no booking created
  execution: executed
  recorded facts: {"url_before": "http://localhost:5177/events/1/book", "url_after": "http://localhost:5177/events/1/book", "title": "Book tickets · Ticket Desk", "headings": ["Book tickets"], "status_messages": ["Choose between 1 and 6 tickets."], "alert_messages": ["Choose between 1 and 6 tickets."], "invalid_fields": [], "text_excerpt": "Ticket Desk · Events Book tickets Harbour Jazz Night Choose between 1 and 6 tickets. Name Email Tickets Book tickets"}

Case 3: Invalid Email Format
  inputs: {"Name": "Charlie", "Email": "charlie-no-at", "Tickets": "1"}
  requirement: T3
  expected: Validation message rejected, no booking created
  execution: executed
  recorded facts: {"url_before": "http://localhost:5177/events/1/book", "url_after": "http://localhost:5177/events/1/book", "title": "Book tickets · Ticket Desk", "headings": ["Book tickets"], "status_messages": ["Enter an email address containing @."], "alert_messages": ["Enter an email address containing @."], "invalid_fields": [], "text_excerpt": "Ticket Desk · Events Book tickets Harbour Jazz Night Enter an email address containing @. Name Email Tickets Book tickets"}

response: {"reasoning": "All cases were executed and the recorded facts (URLs, status messages, and text excerpts) align perfectly with the requirements and expectations.", "assessments": [{"case": 1, "verdict": "as_expected", "observed_summary": "The booking was successful, redirected to a confirmation page showing the correct name and ticket count.", "requirement_ref": "T4"}, {"case": 2, "verdict": "as_expected", "observed_summary": "The form stayed on the booking page and displayed a validation message for the ticket count.", "requirement_ref": "T2"}, {"case": 3, "verdict": "as_expected", "observed_summary": "The form stayed on the booking page and displayed a validation message for the invalid email format.", "requirement_ref": "T3"}]}
